# 大乘入楞伽經

**ID:** T0672
**Volume:** T16
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 唐 實叉難陀譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 700–704
**Juans:** 7
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0672

## Contributors
- 實叉難陀 (A001606)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T672 in seven fascicles is the third and latest of the three extant Chinese translations of the *Laṅkāvatāra-sūtra*. Produced under Empress Wǔ Zétiān 武則天 by [實叉難陀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E5%8F%89%E9%9B%A3%E9%99%80), the great Khotanese translator of the Tang Wǔ Zhōu period (best known for his 80-fascicle *Avataṃsaka*), T672 represents the most polished and literarily refined of the Chinese *Laṅkāvatāra* renderings.

**Abstract**

The translation is canonically ascribed to [實叉難陀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E5%8F%89%E9%9B%A3%E9%99%80) on the basis of the *Kāiyuán shìjiào lù* (T2154) and the *Sòng gāosēng zhuàn* (T2061). The work was begun in 700 at the imperial Dà biànkōngsì 大遍空寺 and Fóshòujìsì 佛授記寺, and completed in 704; the project ran in parallel with [實叉難陀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E5%8F%89%E9%9B%A3%E9%99%80)'s 80-fascicle *Huáyán* (completed 699) and was undertaken with the same translation team — including [菩提流志](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E5%BF%97) Bodhiruci, [義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8) Yìjìng, [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng (as scribe and editor), and the polymath Mítuóshān 彌陀山. The Empress is recorded to have personally edited (筆削) portions of the translation.

T672 is widely regarded — both in the East Asian commentarial tradition and in modern philology — as the most reliable Chinese witness to the underlying Sanskrit, although [T671](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0328) preserves the *Sagāthaka* verse-appendix that T672 abbreviates. The most authoritative classical commentary on T672 is [T1791](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0334) of the Sòng monk [寶臣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E8%87%A3); [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F)'s *Rù Léngqiéxīn xuányì* ([T1790](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0333)) is in part also based on T672.
